verdict.rationale: The only keyboard-related evidence is a roadmap entry for 'Customizable keyboard shortcuts', which is a plan rather than a shipped capability. A community user says Zero 'does not yet have real keyboard navigation', and nothing mentions a command palette. One GitHub note says storing emails in Durable Objects/R2 speeds things up, but that touches only the speed part and does not deliver the keyboard-driven core of the story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait
